title: wolfHSM key discovery: enumerate server keys into g_keys[] at login
description:
After C_Login establishes the whClientContext, enumerate keys that are pre-provisioned on the wolfHSM server and create corresponding g_keys[] entries.

What needs to be done:
- Call wh_Client_KeyList (or equivalent) after successful C_Login to enumerate keys visible to the authenticated client
- For each server key, allocate a wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t with the key ID, type, and size
- Create a g_keys[] entry with backend_ops = &wp11_backend_wolfhsm_ops and key_priv pointing to the allocated struct
- Map wolfHSM key type tags to CKK_RSA / CKK_EC and set sig_len_max accordingly
- Key objects must be cleaned up (freed and slot cleared) at C_Logout

Design decisions:
- Key labels: use the wolfHSM key label field if present; fall back to a hex key ID string
- CKA_TOKEN=TRUE for all server keys (they are persistent on the server)
- CKA_PRIVATE=TRUE for private keys; CKA_PRIVATE=FALSE for public keys if server exposes them separately
- If wolfHSM does not provide an enumeration API, document the manual registration workaround (env var with key ID list)
